analysis.alert_message: CRITICAL ALERT: Patient requires immediate attention!
analysis.summary: Mr. Ravi, a 30-year-old patient with a medium risk and respiratory condition, presents with hypoxia (O2 saturation of 88.0%) and fever (103.0F). Immediate attention is required to determine the cause of his respiratory symptoms and stabilize his oxygen levels.
analysis.guidelines: Administer oxygen therapy, monitor SpO2, chest X-ray recommended.
